victoryMessage: The kingdom of Leon now dominates all of Spain. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: Not too long ago, Leon was united under Castille against the Moorish incursions. Re-establishing that union should be the first order of business, but this time with Leon in the lead. All else will then fall before their might.

victoryMessage: The kingdom of Castille now dominates all of Spain. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: Castille is easily the wealthiest of the Christian kingdoms, and has recently been at the forefront of battles against the Moorish menace. It seems only natural that Castille should be the one to finally unify all of Spain.

victoryMessage: The kingdom of Aragon now dominates all of Spain. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: Aragon descends from the vast kingdom of Sancho the Great, and has since then established a strong sense of independence. While not always the best armed, Aragonese armies are known for their courage and flexibility.

victoryMessage: The kingdom of Portugal now dominates all of Spain. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: Only decades ago Portugal declared its independence under its great King Afonso Henriques. He has led the new kingdom to great victories, but has made terrible enemies of both Leon and the Moors.

victoryMessage: The Empire of the Moors now dominates all of Spain. Your armies stand invincible and your remaining rivals kneel at your feet!
dscr: Although the Moors have lost a lot of territory to the Christian kingdoms over the last few centuries, they have regained their former unity under the new Almohad Caliphate and its great Emir Abu Yaqub Yusuf.
